name: Scandinavian Defence (...Qa5)
summary: One set-up against everything: ...Qa5, ...c6, ...Bf5 and ...e6. Easy to learn, with a few sharp tricks to know.

notes.6: ...Qa5 keeps the queen active and pins the c3 knight once the bishop lands on b4.
notes.10: ...c6 gives the queen a retreat on c7 and controls d5. Play it before ...Bf5.
notes.12: ...Bf5 before ...e6: the bishop is out, and ...e6 next makes the structure a Caro-Kann with an active queen.
notes.16: ...Bb4 pins; White usually breaks it with a3 or plays O-O-O and a3 later.
notes.22: ...Qc7 and ...O-O-O or ...O-O: Black is solid, and the half-open d-file and ...e5 give counterplay.

notes.11: Bd2 prepares Nd5 or Ne4 ideas against the queen. Stay calm: ...Bf5 and ...e6 keep everything covered.
notes.19: Nd5 is the trick: after ...Qd8 (not ...cxd5?? Bxb4) the queen is safe and the knight must retreat or trade; Black is fine.
